evidence.note: A hand begins pulling the right-hand door leaf above the refrigerator.
The right-hand leaf is visibly open while the other leaf remains closed.
Both upper-cabinet leaves remain open.
The remaining projecting cabinet leaf is being swung toward the cabinet.
Both leaves are closed and flush.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above refrigerator — right-hand/first-opened door leaf

evidence.note: The left-hand leaf is still closed after the first leaf has opened.
The user holds and swings the second door leaf outward.
Both door leaves are visibly open.
The user begins handling the open leaves to close the cabinet.
Both leaves are closed and flush.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above refrigerator — left-hand/second-opened door leaf

evidence.note: The wide upper drawer immediately left of the range is closed.
The drawer has been pulled open and the user's hand is at its handle.
The drawer is fully open, exposing stored food items.
The drawer remains fully open.
The drawer is partway inward during closure.
All drawer fronts on the left stack are flush and closed.

events.object_description: Wide upper food-storage drawer immediately left of the range

evidence.note: The upper drawer immediately right of the range is closed.
The user's hand pulls this drawer outward.
The drawer is open, exposing boards and kitchen supplies.
The drawer remains open.
The right-side drawer fronts are flush and closed.

events.object_description: Upper utensil/board-storage drawer immediately right of the range

notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. Four distinct movable parts are counted: two separately manipulated upper-cabinet door leaves and two drawers. The two cabinet closure midpoints are interpolated from the closely spaced closing actions and their leaf assignment is somewhat ambiguous.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both separate door leaves of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens a food-storage drawer left of the range, later closes the cabinet leaves, opens a separate drawer right of the range, and finally closes both drawers.
